name: FlowDrop Field Widget Actions
description: integrates Field Widget Actions with FlowDrop workflows to process field content.
project_description:
FlowDrop Field Widget Actions integrates Field Widget Actions with FlowDrop workflows, allowing content editors to trigger powerful processing logic right from the field they’re editing. No custom PHP. No hard-coded logic. Just visual workflows that can transform, validate, enrich, and generate content on demand.

 Back to top 

 Key Features 
 
 
 FlowDrop Workflow Trigger 

 Add a new Field Widget Action that executes any FlowDrop workflow via AJAX on demand.
 
 
 Full Entity Context 

 Workflows receive values from the entire entity form, not just the field being edited.
 
 
 Multiple Suggestions 

 Generate 1–5 suggestions per execution for editors to choose from.
 
 
 AI-Ready Integration 

 Workflow context is formatted for easy use with AI nodes (e.g., GPT models).
 
 
 Flexible Output Mapping 

 Configure which workflow output key populates the target field.
 
 
 Broad Field Support 

 Works with text fields, textareas, emails, phone numbers, and more.
 
 
 Back to top 

 Typical Use Cases 
 
 Summary Suggestions 
 SEO Metatags Generator 
 Content Quality Checker 
 Auto-tagging Suggestions 
 
 

 
 Contributing 
 
 The FlowDrop FWA module's issue queue is intended for reporting bugs, submitting feature requests, and planning.
 

 

 
 Additionally, you can join the #flowdrop channel on Drupal Slack .
 

 Back to top
